records.title: Online object detection task offloading in UAV ad hoc networks
records.venue: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Unmanned Systems (ICUS), pp. 758-763

evidence.observation: Describes Tiny-YOLO partitioning, task-offloading formulation, state/action/reward design, and the ODO reinforcement-learning method.

records.title: Elastic Collaborative Edge Intelligence for UAV Swarm: Architecture, Challenges, and Opportunities
records.venue: IEEE Communications Magazine, Vol. 62, No. 1, pp. 62-68

evidence.observation: Identifies the article title, authors, and collaborative DNN inference architecture for UAV swarms.
Describes a proof-of-concept prototype using four UAVs, NVIDIA Jetson Nano and TX2 devices, Faster R-CNN, video input, and scheduling.
Evaluates inference before, during, and after UAV unavailability and describes partition rescheduling.
